mapper.select:
SELECT VRA.RESERVATION_ID, VRA.OPEN_AT, VRA.CAFE_ID, VRA.CAFE_NAME, VRA.ROOM_ID, VRA.ROOM_NAME, VRA.LEADER_ID, UA.NICKNAME AS LEADER_NICKNAME, VRA.TOTAL_MEMBER, FN_GET_ATTEND_STATUS(VRA.RESERVATION_ID, VRA.LEADER_ID) AS STATUS_NAME FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN CAFE C ON VRA.CAFE_ID = C.CAFE_ID JOIN USER_ACCOUNT UA ON VRA.LEADER_ID = UA.USER_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} AND VRA.CANCEL_ID IS NULL
AND VRA.OPEN_AT <= SYSDATE + 1/24
ORDER BY VRA.OPEN_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN CAFE C ON VRA.CAFE_ID = C.CAFE_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} AND VRA.CANCEL_ID IS NULL
AND VRA.OPEN_AT <= SYSDATE + 1/24

SELECT VRA.RESERVATION_ID, VRA.OPEN_AT, VRA.CAFE_ID, VRA.CAFE_NAME, VRA.ROOM_ID, VRA.ROOM_NAME, VRA.LEADER_ID, UA.NICKNAME AS LEADER_NICKNAME, VRA.TOTAL_MEMBER, FN_GET_ATTEND_STATUS(VRA.RESERVATION_ID, VRA.LEADER_ID) AS STATUS_NAME FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN VW_ACTIVE_MANAGER VAM ON VAM.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID JOIN USER_ACCOUNT UA ON VRA.LEADER_ID = UA.USER_ID WHERE VAM.USER_ID = #{managerUserId} AND VRA.CANCEL_ID IS NULL
AND VRA.OPEN_AT <= SYSDATE + 1/24
ORDER BY VRA.OPEN_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN VW_ACTIVE_MANAGER VAM ON VAM.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID WHERE VAM.USER_ID = #{managerUserId} AND VRA.CANCEL_ID IS NULL
AND VRA.OPEN_AT <= SYSDATE + 1/24

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA WHERE VRA.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CAFE C WHERE C.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID AND C.USER_ID = #{staffUserId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM VW_ACTIVE_MANAGER VAM WHERE VAM.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID AND VAM.USER_ID = #{staffUserId}) )

SELECT USER_ID, NICKNAME, POSITION FROM ( SELECT P.USER_ID, UA.NICKNAME, 'HOST' AS POSITION FROM PARTY P JOIN USER_ACCOUNT UA ON UA.USER_ID = P.USER_ID JOIN RESERVATION R ON R.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID WHERE R.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} UNION ALL SELECT PA.USER_ID, UA.NICKNAME, 'MEMBER' AS POSITION FROM PARTY_MEMBER PM JOIN PARTY_APPLY PA ON PA.APPLY_ID = PM.APPLY_ID JOIN USER_ACCOUNT UA ON UA.USER_ID = PA.USER_ID JOIN RESERVATION R ON R.PARTY_ID = PA.PARTY_ID WHERE R.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PARTY_KICK PK WHERE PK.MEMBER_ID = PM.MEMBER_ID ) ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA WHERE VRA.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CAFE C WHERE C.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID AND C.USER_ID = #{staffUserId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM VW_ACTIVE_MANAGER VAM WHERE VAM.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID AND VAM.USER_ID = #{staffUserId}) ) ) ORDER BY DECODE(POSITION, 'HOST', 0, 1), USER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTENDANCE_DETAIL (DETAIL_ID, ATTENDANCE_ID, USER_ID, ATTEND_STATUS_ID) VALUES (ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{attendanceId}, #{userId}, #{attendStatusId})
mapper.select: SELECT VRA.RESERVATION_ID, VRA.OPEN_AT, VRA.CAFE_ID, VRA.CAFE_NAME, VRA.ROOM_ID, VRA.ROOM_NAME, VRA.LEADER_ID, UA.NICKNAME AS LEADER_NICKNAME, VRA.TOTAL_MEMBER, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE_DETAIL AD JOIN ATTENDANCE A2 ON A2.ATTENDANCE_ID = AD.ATTENDANCE_ID WHERE A2.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID AND AD.ATTEND_STATUS_ID = 1) AS DONE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE_DETAIL AD JOIN ATTENDANCE A2 ON A2.ATTENDANCE_ID = AD.ATTENDANCE_ID WHERE A2.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID AND AD.ATTEND_STATUS_ID = 2) AS NOSHOW_COUNT FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN CAFE C ON VRA.CAFE_ID = C.CAFE_ID JOIN USER_ACCOUNT UA ON VRA.LEADER_ID = UA.USER_ID JOIN ATTENDANCE A ON A.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} ORDER BY VRA.OPEN_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN CAFE C ON VRA.CAFE_ID = C.CAFE_ID JOIN ATTENDANCE A ON A.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{ownerUserId}

SELECT VRA.RESERVATION_ID, VRA.OPEN_AT, VRA.CAFE_ID, VRA.CAFE_NAME, VRA.ROOM_ID, VRA.ROOM_NAME, VRA.LEADER_ID, UA.NICKNAME AS LEADER_NICKNAME, VRA.TOTAL_MEMBER, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE_DETAIL AD JOIN ATTENDANCE A2 ON A2.ATTENDANCE_ID = AD.ATTENDANCE_ID WHERE A2.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID AND AD.ATTEND_STATUS_ID = 1) AS DONE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE_DETAIL AD JOIN ATTENDANCE A2 ON A2.ATTENDANCE_ID = AD.ATTENDANCE_ID WHERE A2.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID AND AD.ATTEND_STATUS_ID = 2) AS NOSHOW_COUNT FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN VW_ACTIVE_MANAGER VAM ON VAM.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID JOIN USER_ACCOUNT UA ON VRA.LEADER_ID = UA.USER_ID JOIN ATTENDANCE A ON A.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID WHERE VAM.USER_ID = #{managerUserId} ORDER BY VRA.OPEN_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA JOIN VW_ACTIVE_MANAGER VAM ON VAM.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID JOIN ATTENDANCE A ON A.RESERVATION_ID = VRA.RESERVATION_ID WHERE VAM.USER_ID = #{managerUserId}

SELECT AD.USER_ID, UA.NICKNAME, AD.ATTEND_STATUS_ID, TS.STATUS_NAME FROM ATTENDANCE A JOIN ATTENDANCE_DETAIL AD ON A.ATTENDANCE_ID = AD.ATTENDANCE_ID JOIN USER_ACCOUNT UA ON AD.USER_ID = UA.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ATTEND_STATUS TS ON AD.ATTEND_STATUS_ID = TS.STATUS_ID WHERE A.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM VW_RESERVATION_ALL VRA WHERE VRA.RESERVATION_ID = A.RESERVATION_ID AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CAFE C WHERE C.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID AND C.USER_ID = #{staffUserId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM VW_ACTIVE_MANAGER VAM WHERE VAM.CAFE_ID = VRA.CAFE_ID AND VAM.USER_ID = #{staffUserId}) ) ) ORDER BY AD.USER_ID
